changeSet.author: Codex
changeSet.comment: Migrated boards retain original raster objects alongside their independent v2 copies. Queue both sets before board deletion removes the owner rows. Legacy cleanup keys must identify this exact page and a canonical hash; workers only delete them after the page is gone, protecting live legacy catalogs and upload receipts. Physical cleanup never releases quota again. Rollback requires legacy cleanup jobs to have been drained and removed first.
